description: Return rule pages. format "checklist": each page as its slug, title, description and a short list of the rules to follow, without the body or code; leave out category to get every page in one call (about 16 KB). format "full" (default, needs a category): each page with title, description, checklist, markdown body and all HTML/CSS code examples. Start with the checklists, then fetch the pages you need with get_rule. Components are not included: use list_components / get_component.

category.description: Which rule category to fetch. Required for format "full"; optional for "checklist".

format.description: full (default): whole pages with code. checklist: titles and rules only.

name: get_playbook_rules
